description: A Pre-Application Workshop can help students feel confident and prepared as they begin the application process for their professional programs. During the session, students can learn how to navigate application systems, organize materials, and understand key deadlines. The workshop also provides insight into what admissions committees look for, helping students present their experiences and goals effectively. Overall, it’s a valuable opportunity to ask questions, clarify requirements, and develop a strong plan for a successful application.
